tasks.question: Is there a splash pad or water play at Dix Park, and when does it operate?
tasks.reason: The verified water play answer expired and needs rechecking.
tasks.previousAnswer: Yes. The interactive waterfall and splash pad are at Fountain Plaza within Gipson Play Plaza. Watermill Mountain, the waterfall, and splash pad start at 10 a.m.; the splash pad operates through October, while the waterfall can operate year-round as weather permits. Water features shut down when lightning is detected within 10 miles and can restart 20 minutes after the lightning clears.
